_about: Operations on which a schema-valid request is correctly refused, so the single check positive_data_acceptance (valid data must be accepted) is skipped for them; every other check still runs. This file is the only list: tests/contract/test_openapi_contract.py and scripts/contract_cli.sh both read it, and a test fails if an entry does not match the OpenAPI document. 'suites' says which runner skips the check.

operations.reason: end_date >= start_date spans two fields, which OpenAPI 3.0 cannot state (FR-028); answered 422 projects.date_range_invalid
same date-order rule as the create (FR-028)
a time zone must be an exact name on the IANA list that loads (FR-217, FR-231), which no schema can state; any short string is schema-valid and a made-up one is answered 422 sites.timezone_invalid
same time zone rule as the create (FR-217)
the command-line run itself creates users and then guesses their passwords, so the account lockout (423) is the designed answer
contract_end >= contract_start spans two fields, which OpenAPI cannot state (FR-243); answered 422 clients.date_range_invalid
same date-order rule as the create, judged against the stored start (FR-243)
ends_on >= starts_on spans two fields (003 FR-106), answered 422 windows.date_range_invalid; a period that shares a date with another window is answered 409 windows.overlap
the date order, the weekday and the absence fields span several fields (003 FR-101, FR-102), and the window rule depends on stored windows (FR-105); answered 422 or 409 with availability.* codes
the same rules as adding an entry (003 FR-104, FR-105)
a type may not start and end at the same time, which spans two fields (003 FR-110); answered 422 shift_types.times_equal
the same rule as adding a type, judged with the stored time of the field not sent
a cursor must be one this API returned, which no schema can state; any other text is answered 422 shifts.cursor_invalid
the times span two fields and the shift type must be one the project uses, which depends on stored data (003 FR-111, FR-113); answered 422 shifts.times_invalid or shifts.type_not_in_project
the new times are judged with the stored time of the field not sent (003 FR-114); answered 422 shifts.times_invalid
to >= from spans two fields (003 FR-121), answered 422 shifts.date_range_invalid
the publish's own range rule, to >= from, spans two fields (007 FR-036); answered 422 shifts.date_range_invalid

a person's own times come as a pair, end after they start and stay within 4 hours of the stored shift's times (007 FR-027), which spans fields and stored data; answered 422 assignment.times_invalid or assignment.times_out_of_range
the same own-times rule as the assignment's create (007 FR-027); answered 422 assignment.times_invalid or assignment.times_out_of_range
to >= from spans two parameters, answered 422 shifts.date_range_invalid

a need's shift type must be one the project uses (004 FR-001), which no schema can state; a random id is answered 422 requirements.shift_type_not_in_project, and a repeated shift type and weekday 422 requirements.duplicate

to >= from and at most 31 days span two fields (004 FR-005), answered 422 schedule.range_invalid; a project id must be an active project of the organisation, answered 422 schedule.project_not_active; a Manager may name only projects they manage, answered 403 roster.project_not_managed, and with none named needs a project of their own, answered 422 schedule.no_projects (007 T108)
a cursor must be one the API returned, which no schema can state; any other string is answered 422 schedule.cursor_invalid
a weekly rest whose start and end are the same moment spans four fields, which OpenAPI 3.0 cannot state (005 FR-003); answered 422 pay.rest_window_invalid
an ended project's settings are fixed (005 FR-007), which depends on stored state; answered 409 pay.project_ended, and the rest-window rule above as 422
one organisation day per date (005 FR-008) depends on stored days; answered 409 special_days.duplicate, and a blank name 422 special_days.name_required
a date already taken, or a day of an ended project, depends on stored state (005 FR-008a); answered 409 special_days.duplicate or pay.project_ended
one day per project and date, and an ended project's days are fixed (005 FR-008a); answered 409 special_days.duplicate or pay.project_ended

at most one of three optional ids, a start needed for a site, a group or the whole organisation (no id, 007 PR 5), and a range of at most 366 days span several parameters, which OpenAPI 3.0 cannot state (005 FR-023, FR-024, FR-030); answered 422 reports.scope_invalid, reports.start_required or reports.range_invalid
to on or after from and at most 366 days later spans two parameters (005 FR-030); answered 422 reports.range_invalid
each id must be an active Manager or Admin of the organisation (005 FR-021), which depends on stored users; any other UUID is answered 422 project_managers.not_staff
opening hours name each weekday at most once and close after they open (007 FR-012), which spans items and fields and OpenAPI 3.0 cannot state; answered 422 organisation.opening_hours_invalid
both weeks must start on a Sunday (007 FR-038), which no date format can state; answered 422 roster.week_not_sunday
the week must start on a Sunday (007 FR-038); answered 422 roster.week_not_sunday
the week must start on a Sunday (007 FR-038); answered 422 roster.week_not_sunday
exactly one of headcount and remove (007 FR-038), which spans two fields and OpenAPI 3.0 cannot state; answered 422 roster.bulk_change_invalid

accepting depends on stored state: the job must have an open proposal (409 schedule.not_ready or schedule.proposal_closed), and a Manager must manage every project of the run at the time (403 roster.project_not_managed, 007 T108); an If-Match that is not the stored version is answered 412 schedule.version_stale (008 FR-007)

discarding depends on stored state: the job must have an open proposal (409 schedule.not_ready or schedule.proposal_closed), and a Manager must manage every project of the run at the time (403 roster.project_not_managed, 007 T108); an If-Match that is not the stored version is answered 412 schedule.version_stale (008 FR-007)
a name is unique per user and screen (007 FR-043), which depends on stored views; a second view of the same name is answered 409 views.duplicate_name

whether an edit fits depends on the stored proposal (the person must be on, or not on, the named shift) and the stored roster (a rule break needs override_reason), which no schema can state; a schema-valid edit is answered 422 schedule.edit_invalid or schedule.override_reason_required (008 FR-008 to FR-010); an If-Match that is not the stored version is answered 412 schedule.version_stale

undoing depends on the stored run record: there must be an edit not yet undone whose shifts have no part accepted since (409 schedule.nothing_to_undo), and an If-Match that is not the stored version is answered 412 schedule.version_stale (008 FR-011, FR-007)
